title: [Subcontracting] Bug 648843: Align feature-handler references with CLEAN28
summary: Subcontracting app handler references are realigned with CLEAN28 boundaries by adding 425 feature-flag guards for handler declarations and calls, plus removing 17 redundant cached-flag checks that depend on those handlers.
key_points: Added CLEAN28 compatibility guards around 425 SubcFeatureFlagHandler references across 81 files to match the handler's existing obsolescence boundary
Removed 17 checks of the cached SubcontractingEnabled variable that would otherwise create unresolved references when handlers are guarded
Preserved CLEAN27 guards for Italian legacy-handler references and objects already marked obsolete at 27.0
No changes to obsoletion tags, schema boundaries, application-area setup, or unrelated tests
Validated through static source audit confirming exact handler-guard coverage and preservation of non-handler logic
